_activity: Build it: name the principle at stake
_licence: ORIGINAL, built on the 11.2 casefile documents (numbered per the signed 11.2 map). Quotes are the casefile's adapted text.
intro: Build the sentence. Drag the correct piece into each blank.
sentence_frame: The ___ put the principle of ___ at stake, because ___.

tiles.text: it punished people for speaking and printing criticism of the government
it split power between the nation and the states
it let courts strike down laws

correct_sentence: The Sedition Act of 1798 put the principle of Individual Rights (civil liberties) at stake, because it punished people for speaking and printing criticism of the government.
rationale: Name the principle with the card's words, then show why it's at stake. The Sedition Act tested the First Amendment seven years after it was ratified.
hints: Speech and press are which principle on your card?
